title: A coaching exercise distinguishes completion from independence
method: Synthetic four-task coaching exercise. Follow-up checks occur one week later and test different capabilities; they are not a causal estimate of AI effects or an employee performance score.
alt: A coaching exercise distinguishes completion from independence. Completed with assistance: 4 tasks out of four, Explained later: 3 tasks out of four, Tests reproduced: 2 tasks out of four, New variation diagnosed: 1 tasks out of four. Illustrative data.
